products.details:
# Product Management

## Overview

The **Product Management** page is your central command for everything related to your inventory. It provides a rich, interactive interface to view, search, and manage all the products you sell.

### Key Features

- **Product Grid:** A visually appealing grid that displays all your products as cards. Each card provides a quick overview of the product.
- **Advanced Search & Filter:**
    - Use the main search bar to instantly find products by **name** or **barcode**.
    - A sophisticated **category browser** allows you to drill down and filter the product list to a specific category or sub-category.
- **Core Actions:**
    - **Add Product:** Opens a modal form to create a new product from scratch.
    - **View Details:** Click on any product card to open a modal with a detailed, read-only view of the product's information.
    - **Edit Product:** Allows you to modify the information for an existing product.
    - **Delete Product:** Permanently removes a product from the system. A confirmation prompt ensures you don't delete something by accident.
- **Insightful Reports:**
    - **Performance Analysis:** Access a dedicated view with charts and statistics to analyze product performance, showing you top sellers and purchase trends.
    - **Activity Report:** Get insights into your operational efficiency by seeing statistics on when products were created and last updated.

add_products.name: Add Product
add_products.description: Use this form to add new products to your catalog.
add_products.details:
# Add/Edit Product Form

## Overview

The **Add/Edit Product** form is a versatile tool for managing the core details of your products. Whether you're adding a new item to your inventory or updating an existing one, this form provides all the necessary fields.

### Form Fields

- **Product Name:** The primary, user-facing name of the product.
- **Initial Price:** The cost of the product when you purchased it (the cost price).
- **Price:** The price at which you sell the product to customers (the selling price).
- **Quantity:** The current stock level for this product.
- **Quantity Almost Depleted:** A threshold that, when reached, will trigger a low-stock warning.
- **Barcode:** The product's barcode for easy scanning with a barcode reader.
- **Category:** The category the product belongs to (e.g., `Electronics > Laptops`). This helps in organizing your products.

### Image Management

The form offers two convenient ways to add an image to your product:
1.  **Automatic:** If you don't upload an image, the system will automatically fetch a relevant image from an online service based on the product's name. This saves you time.
2.  **Manual Upload:** You have the option to upload your own custom image file for the product, giving you full control over its presentation.

sales_invoices.name: Sales Invoices
sales_invoices.description: Manage all invoices related to customer sales.
sales_invoices.details:
# Sales & Purchase Management (Invoices & Orders)

## Overview

This is a powerful and feature-rich component for displaying and managing lists of **invoices** and **orders**. It is highly configurable and serves as the backbone for tracking both sales and purchases, providing extensive filtering and search capabilities.

### Key Features

- **Unified Interface:** A single, consistent interface is used to display lists of invoices or orders, for both sales and purchases.
- **Advanced Filtering:** Allows you to precisely filter the list by:
    - **Date Range**
    - **Customer** or **Supplier**
    - A specific **Product** (to see all transactions involving that product)
    - The user who **Created** the transaction
    - The user who **Executed** the transaction
    - **Order Status** (e.g., Pending, Shipped, Delivered)
- **Global Search:** A powerful search bar to quickly find items by ID, customer/supplier name, amount, or payment status.
- **Detailed Modal View:** Clicking on any row opens a modal with a comprehensive view of the selected invoice or order, showing all line items, payment history, and more.
- **Quick Actions:** Each item in the list has a menu with actions to **Edit** or **Delete** it.
- **Status Badges:** Clear, color-coded badges for **Payment Status** (e.g., Paid, Unpaid) and **Order Status** make it easy to understand the state of each transaction at a glance.
- **Dark Mode Ready:** The entire component is beautifully styled for a seamless experience in dark mode.

add_sales_invoice.name: Create Sales Invoice
add_sales_invoice.description: Generate a new invoice for a customer sale.
add_sales_invoice.details:
# Create Sales Invoice/Order

## Overview

This dynamic form is used to create a new **sales transaction** (either an invoice or an order). The workflow is designed to be fast and efficient.

### Workflow

1.  **Select a Customer:** Start by choosing a customer from your list. You can also **add a new customer** on the fly if they don't exist in the system.
2.  **Add Products:** Search for and add products to the transaction list.
3.  **Specify Quantity & Price:** For each product, you can specify the quantity and the selling price.
4.  **Stock Management:** The form automatically checks for available stock for the products you add and will warn you if you try to sell more than you have.
5.  **Manage Payments:** You can record payments made against the invoice.
6.  **Delivery Details:** For sales orders, you can add and manage delivery information.

add_purchase_invoice.name: Create Purchase Invoice
add_purchase_invoice.description: Record a new invoice received from a supplier.
add_purchase_invoice.details:
# Create Purchase Invoice/Order

## Overview

This form is for recording a new **purchase transaction** (invoice or order) from a supplier. It helps you keep track of your incoming stock and expenses.

### Workflow

1.  **Select a Supplier:** Choose the supplier you are purchasing from. You can also **add a new supplier** directly from this form.
2.  **Add Products:** Add the products you purchased, specifying the quantity and the purchase price.
3.  **Expiration Date Management:** When creating a purchase invoice, the system will prompt you to enter **expiration dates** for the products you are receiving. This is a critical feature for inventory management, especially for perishable goods.
4.  **On-the-fly Creation:** You can add new products to the system directly from this form if they don't already exist in your catalog.
